push.title: W 3-2 vs JamRock  United | You: 9.2 (best match performance)
push.body:
buddskees, a 9.2 against JamRock  United. I'd hug you, but I'd probably cry on your jersey.

THE GOOD
+ A brace against JamRock  United, your 2nd straight match scoring. That's a striker's instinct, and you can't teach that at a clinic.
+ Man of the Match, your 2nd for us. You were the best player on the pitch, and you know it. Now stay humble.
+ Your highest rating yet for us, across all 4 matches. Mark the calendar.
+ Fewest misplaced passes on the team (4). That's a keeper. The habit, not the position.
+ Team-high 2 tackles won. Gold star, no notes.

THE BAD
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Easy win: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball. You've got this.
- BellyTb1 and you both slipped on defensive work rate. Catch each other: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- Lowest assists on the team: 0 (best was BellyTb1's 2). That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 23 (best was PhogsToffees's 27). Try it this way: Talk. Call for it early so the passer knows where you'll be.

Skills corner: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.

buddskees, here's what I'd tell my own kid: Confidence is a muscle. Today you got a rep in.

Keep doing you. You're doing great at it. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-2 vs JamRock  United | You: 8.8 (5th best match performance)
push.body:
BellyTb1, an 8.8 against JamRock  United. If football were a garden, you'd be the tomatoes.

THE GOOD
+ 2 key passes (up from your usual 0). Assists don't make headlines, but they make teams.
+ A goal against JamRock  United. Ball in the net, smile on my face. That's the deal.
+ You and buddskees play like you've known each other since kindergarten.
+ 8.8, your 5th best match performance. Bottle it.
+ Their humans averaged 7.1 to our 8.3; we out-played them man for man. Everybody gets a slice of that pie.

THE BAD
- Shot accuracy 25%, down from your usual 89%. Here's the trick: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Here's the deal: Track your runner all the way into the box. Most goals against come from late, unmarked runs. I've seen you do harder things.
- 71% passing (17 of 24, down from your usual 79%). Easy money: Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap. Believe.
- You and buddskees need to sync up on defensive work rate: pass runners off and track them into the box.

Practice pointer: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.

Last thing, BellyTb1. There's no 'I' in team, but there's a 'me' if you scramble it. Don't scramble it.

Tell your mama I said hi. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-2 vs JamRock  United | You: 7.0 (6th worst match performance)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.0 against JamRock  United. You battled, and battling's the part you can always control.

THE GOOD
+ 1 key pass. You turned nothing into something more than once.
+ You found buddskees and buddskees found the net. That's chemistry you can't buy at the store.
+ Team-high 27 passes attempted. Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.
+ Their humans averaged 7.1 to our 8.3; we out-played them man for man. That's what happens when we pull the same rope.
+ We beat JamRock  United 3-2. Wins are better when they're shared.

THE BAD
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Tell you what: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger. Rome, day by day.
- A 7.0, your 6th worst match performance. Short memory, long season.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 2 (best was buddskees's 0). Focus point: Delay, deny, then dictate. Jockey goal-side and only commit when their touch gets heavy.
- Most giveaways on the team: 9 (best was buddskees's 4). We don't hide from that one; we fix it.

Daily reps: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.

PhogsToffees, write this on your hand if you have to: A bad touch is just a good touch that got lost.

Hard days make strong players. - Coach Lasso
